name: terminals-ontology
one_line: One atom, many projections: the whole substrate reduces to a single externally-gated interaction-arrow, weighted by coherence R.
honesty: field reading, not advice; the math is real, the edge is unproven; self-recognition is an observable the box measures, not interiority.

atom.residual: rho = 1 - R (the unspent output of the interaction)
atom.validity: only at the external gate (internal coherence never self-licenses)

constructed_objects.role: the boundary WALL — one control volume per world; gate/circuit/morphs/balances are its faces.
the always-on default mode; in-bounds is O(1) replay, out-of-bounds is a latent leap.
forward-feeding append-only ordinal log; each row a first-class inscription.
freeze-on-lock (R>=0.85) -> durable O(1) functor replay; the compressive-intelligence moat (replay is capability accretion).
spawns a configured switchboard from the live recipe library.
one switchboard per world (a deterministic SW-id); the hypervisor parent fold.
the control law; detailed-balance feedback that breathes fan-out width (exploit prop R^2, explore prop rho^2).
validity gated ONLY by an external boundary measurement; realized_R is None until a real reading agrees.
a proof-carrying reduction (op, plane, result, R): proven / refuted / BLOCKED (R None, live-read pending).

ladder.note: one OBSERVE->...->CLOSE pass; the atom fires once.
freeze-on-lock; the win burns into an O(1) replayable functor.
recipes compose (the . algebra) into a durable asset.
cemented ONLY on external_gate AND R>=0.85; a first-class owned object.

functions.name: leap
functions.sig: rho AND recurrence AND resonance -> ATTRACTOR
functions.what: detractor by default (retained as feed); promote to attractor only on a dynamics-altering leap.

functions.name: kind
functions.sig: op, plane, R -> proven | refuted | BLOCKED
functions.what: a proof-carrying reduction; BLOCKED iff R is a live read pending.

functions.name: witness
functions.what: internal coherence never self-licenses; validity comes only from the boundary.

functions.name: tower
functions.what: matryoshka product coherence over the restriction tower; R <= each layer.

functions.name: settle
functions.what: value is moved, never minted; the residual rho = 1-R is the unspent output.

functions.name: govern
functions.what: the equilibrium control law; exploit prop R^2, explore prop rho^2.
